thesis: The world is not a finished dashboard; it is a living organism that grows new organs from traces, constraints and receipts.
high_level_seed: cellular adaptation -> communal behavior -> world formation -> civilization of receipts

variants.name: trace-cell
variants.arc: one trace enters a dark medium, senses a question, grows a route filament and seals a receipt

variants.name: colony-of-agents
variants.arc: 17 agent organisms cluster, exchange stigmergic filaments, specialize into route organs and form an EON stratum
variants.ending: a missing organ becomes the next quest

variants.name: world-seed
variants.arc: a source seed becomes terrain, authority fields appear, and receipts crystallize as navigable landmarks
variants.ending: World remains read-only and partially unexplored

variants.name: receipt-civilization
variants.arc: several EON strata accumulate into a civilization whose laws are provenance, falsifiability and repair
variants.ending: the civilization opens a new question rather than claiming completion

selection_gate: source parity + object identity + outsider clarity + reduced-motion + falsifier
